title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koepka’s Portugal Trip
items.text: Brooks Koepka took tequila shots every hole during a Portugal golf trip before withdrawing from the Rocket Classic, with his next start at the Wyndham Championship aiming at FedEx Cup playoffs.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Ibiza Appearance
items.text: Rory McIlroy made his first public appearance post-backlash by partying at Pacha Ibiza during his self-declared break from PGA Tour until the FedEx St.

items.headline: Hull’s Women’s Open Admission
items.text: Charley Hull revealed Royal Lytham & St Annes is a tough layout that doesn't suit her eye, reducing pressure as she pursues her first major amid recent injury-affected form.
